_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for AI models, their upstream ids, retail rates and credit costs. Swap a model here (ids, displayName, inputPerM/outputPerM) — pricing, credit debits, the model picker and the marketing copy all follow. Rates are provider USD per 1M tokens expressed in credit units of providerUnitUsd (e.g. $2/M -> 400). creditMarkupFactor applies to images, chatMarkupFactor to text. Rebuild + restart web & worker after editing.

_imageFormatsComment: Output ratios offered to merchants. `aspectRatio` is passed verbatim to kie's `aspect_ratio` input (and to OpenRouter's image_config.aspect_ratio on the Gemini fallback). `maxResolution` encodes the provider's documented ratio x resolution limits — GPT-Image 2 refuses 1:1 above 2K — so the pipeline clamps instead of failing the job. `auto` keeps the source photo's ratio and is the default, i.e. the historical behaviour.
_imageToolsComment: Post-processing tools billed like images (provider units x creditMarkupFactor, no alt text). removeBackground = Recraft segmentation via kie; measured 2026-09-21: 1 kie unit, 3-8 s, transparent PNG/WebP following the input format, the documented 5 MB cap is not enforced (6.9 MB accepted).
_shopifyBillingComment: Prices charged through Shopify Billing to merchants who installed the app from the Shopify admin (the App Store forbids off-platform billing). Shopify bills app charges in USD. Rule: same value as the euro price (EUR/USD 1.1382 on 2026-09-27) with Shopify's 2.9% processing fee absorbed, rounded to .99, so a Shopify merchant pays what a web customer pays and the net per sale matches Stripe. Offers rank by price per credit exactly as on the site. Yearly = monthly x 12 x (1 - yearly discount), like Stripe. Revisit if EUR/USD moves by more than ~5%. Development stores can only pay in test mode: a test charge activates the plan or pack but credits at most testCreditCap per account, never refilled (otherwise any Shopify partner gets free plans and packs).
_wixBillingComment: Prices charged through Wix Billing to merchants who installed the app from Wix (the App Market requires Wix Billing for any charge). Wix sets local prices from these USD amounts. Wix keeps a 2.5% fee the first year, then 20% + 2.5%, and a price increase only ever applies to new customers, so the prices carry the long-term cut from day one: EUR price x 1.1382 (EUR/USD 2026-09-27) / 0.78, rounded up to .99, so that after the first year the net per sale matches Stripe. Offers rank by price per credit exactly as on the site. Yearly = monthly x 12 x (1 - yearly discount), set the same in the Wix app dashboard. productIds are the plan GUIDs from the Wix app dashboard (Pricing), null until created: a null plan cannot be bought. During development Wix prices every plan at 0.00: a purchase at 0.00 is a test purchase and grants at most shopifyBilling.testCreditCap credits per account in total (shared with Shopify test charges), never refilled.
